#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""OUT1/OUT2 machine verification of the committed r5-node graph (C11 + parity checks)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PLUGIN = Path("/Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/harness/plugins/dev-graph")
ROOT = Path("/Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/harness/eval-log/dev-graph/live-trial-fixtures/r5-node")
EVAL = ROOT / "eval-log"
CONTRACT = json.loads((PLUGIN / "templates" / "template-contract.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ROOT_BY_KIND = CONTRACT["graph_projection"]["root_map"]
REQUIRED_FRONTMATTER = CONTRACT["common_frontmatter"]["required"]
PLACEHOLDERS = CONTRACT["placeholder_tokens"]
IDENTITY_KEYS = ("graph_node_id", "artifact_kind", "file_path", "template_id", "template_version")

checks: list[dict] = []


def check(name: str, ok: bool, detail) -> None:
    checks.append({"check": name, "status": "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "detail": detail})


def headings(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {m.group(2).strip() for m in re.finditer(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*$", text, re.M)}


def template_sections(name: str) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    text = (PLUGIN / "templates" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    title, sections = None, []
    for match in re.finditer(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*$", text, re.M):
        if len(match.group(1)) == 1 and title is None:
            title = match.group(2).strip()
        else:
            sections.append(match.group(2).strip())
    return title, sections


def frontmatter_of(path: Path) -> dict:
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    assert lines[0].strip() == "---"
    result = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if line.strip() == "---":
            break
        match = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*):(?:\s*(.*))?$", line)
        if match:
            raw = (match.group(2) or "").strip()
            try:
                result[match.group(1)] = json.loads(raw) if raw else ""
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                result[match.group(1)] = raw
    return result


def body_of(path: Path) -> str:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return text.split("---", 2)[2]


graph = json.loads((ROOT / ".dev-graph" / "state" / "graph.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
nodes = {node["graph_node_id"]: node for node in graph["nodes"]}

# 1. C11 on the committed graph
cp = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, str(PLUGIN / "scripts" / "validate-graph-schema.py"),
     "--graph", str(ROOT / ".dev-graph" / "state" / "graph.json"), "--repo-root", str(ROOT)],
    text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
)
c11 = json.loads(cp.stdout)
check("C11 validate-graph-schema exit 0", cp.returncode == 0, {"exit_code": cp.returncode, "violations": c11["violations"]})
check("C11 valid=true", c11["valid"] is True, {"missing_sections": c11["missing_sections"]})

# 2. five kinds, one each, canonical roots
kinds = sorted(node["artifact_kind"] for node in graph["nodes"])
check("5 kind exactly once", kinds == ["architecture", "document", "issue", "specification", "task"], kinds)
check("no duplicate graph_node_id", len(nodes) == len(graph["nodes"]), len(graph["nodes"]))
path_parity = {
    node["graph_node_id"]: node["file_path"].split("/")[0] == ROOT_BY_KIND[node["artifact_kind"]]
    for node in graph["nodes"]
}
check("kind -> canonical root parity", all(path_parity.values()), path_parity)
existence = {node["file_path"]: (ROOT / node["file_path"]).is_file() for node in graph["nodes"]}
check("artifact files exist at canonical path", all(existence.values()), existence)

# 3. frontmatter required keys and identity parity
frontmatter_report = {}
for node in graph["nodes"]:
    front = frontmatter_of(ROOT / node["file_path"])
    missing = [key for key in REQUIRED_FRONTMATTER if key not in front]
    mismatched = [key for key in IDENTITY_KEYS if front.get(key) != node.get(key)]
    frontmatter_report[node["graph_node_id"]] = {"missing": missing, "mismatched": mismatched}
check(
    "frontmatter required keys + identity parity",
    all(not value["missing"] and not value["mismatched"] for value in frontmatter_report.values()),
    frontmatter_report,
)

# 4. required body sections per kind, architecture subtypes, specification api overlay
section_report = {}
for node in graph["nodes"]:
    kind = node["artifact_kind"]
    spec = CONTRACT["artifacts"][kind]
    required = list(spec["required_sections"])
    if kind == "architecture":
        for subtype in node["artifact_subtypes"]:
            title, sections = template_sections(spec["subtype_templates"][subtype])
            required.append(title)
            required.extend(sections)
    if kind == "specification" and "api" in node["artifact_subtypes"]:
        _, overlay = template_sections(spec["conditional_templates"]["api_changed"])
        required.extend(overlay)
    body = body_of(ROOT / node["file_path"])
    present = headings(body)
    section_report[node["graph_node_id"]] = {
        "required": len(set(required)),
        "missing": sorted(set(required) - present),
        "placeholder_tokens": sorted({token for token in PLACEHOLDERS if token in body}),
    }
check(
    "kind/subtype/overlay required sections missing 0",
    all(not value["missing"] and not value["placeholder_tokens"] for value in section_report.values()),
    section_report,
)
architecture = nodes["arch-notification-delivery-subsystem"]
check("architecture subtypes == [backend, security]", sorted(architecture["artifact_subtypes"]) == ["backend", "security"], architecture["artifact_subtypes"])
specification = nodes["spec-notification-preferences-api"]
spec_body = body_of(ROOT / specification["file_path"])
endpoints = sorted(h for h in headings(spec_body) if h.startswith("API: "))
check("specification api subtype + api-contract endpoint blocks", "api" in specification["artifact_subtypes"] and len(endpoints) >= 2, {"subtypes": specification["artifact_subtypes"], "endpoints": endpoints})
check(
    "specification readiness complete",
    specification["implementation_readiness"]["status"] == "complete",
    specification["implementation_readiness"],
)

# 5. no direct feature registration
feature_nodes = [node["graph_node_id"] for node in graph["nodes"] if node["artifact_kind"] == "feature"]
features_dir = sorted(path.name for path in (ROOT / "features").glob("*.md"))
rejection = json.loads((EVAL / "run-dev-graph-node-feature-rejection-receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
check("feature nodes in graph == 0", feature_nodes == [], feature_nodes)
check("features/ markdown files == 0", features_dir == [], features_dir)
check(
    "direct feature add fail-closed with applied_count 0",
    rejection["status"] == "FAIL_CLOSED" and rejection["applied_count"] == 0
    and rejection["graph_revision_before"] == rejection["graph_revision_after"]
    and rejection["written_paths"] == [],
    {"status": rejection["status"], "code": rejection["rejection_code"], "applied_count": rejection["applied_count"]},
)

# 6. identity invariance across consecutive updates
add_receipt = json.loads((EVAL / "run-dev-graph-node-add-receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
update_receipts = [
    json.loads((EVAL / f"run-dev-graph-node-{name}-receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for name in ("update-task", "update-issue-1", "update-issue-2")
]
issue_id = "issue-login-notification-center-empty"
paths = [add_receipt["registered_paths"][issue_id]] + [receipt["identity_after"][issue_id] for receipt in update_receipts]
check("issue canonical path invariant across updates", len(set(paths)) == 1, paths)
check("issue graph_node_id present in every receipt", all(issue_id in receipt["identity_after"] for receipt in update_receipts), True)
issue_node = nodes[issue_id]
check(
    "issue created_at frozen, updated_at advanced",
    issue_node["created_at"] < issue_node["updated_at"],
    {"created_at": issue_node["created_at"], "updated_at": issue_node["updated_at"]},
)
issue_updates = [receipt for receipt in update_receipts if issue_id in receipt["diff_report"]]
check(
    "issue updates changed only intended sections",
    len(issue_updates) == 2 and all(
        receipt["diff_report"][issue_id]["changed_sections"] == receipt["diff_report"][issue_id]["intended_sections"]
        and receipt["diff_report"][issue_id]["unmanaged_sections_unchanged"]
        for receipt in issue_updates
    ),
    [receipt["diff_report"][issue_id] for receipt in issue_updates],
)
check(
    "node count stable at 5 after updates and rejection",
    len(graph["nodes"]) == 5 and add_receipt["applied_count"] == 5,
    {"nodes": len(graph["nodes"]), "add_applied_count": add_receipt["applied_count"]},
)
check(
    "graph_revision monotonic 0 -> 4",
    graph["graph_revision"] == 4,
    {"graph_revision": graph["graph_revision"]},
)

# 7. goal-seek intermediate integrity (SKILL.md ゴールシーク検証)
goal = json.loads((EVAL / "run-dev-graph-node-goal-spec.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (EVAL / "run-dev-graph-node-intermediate.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
required_keys = {"original_goal", "original_goal_hash", "current_goal_snapshot", "delta_from_original", "merged_directive_for_next", "drift_signal"}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal["original_goal"].encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
ok = bool(rows) and all(
    required_keys <= row.keys() and row["original_goal"] == goal["original_goal"] and row["original_goal_hash"] == expected
    for row in rows
)
check("goal-seek intermediate rows keyed and hash-pinned", ok, {"rows": len(rows), "hash": expected[:16]})

report = {
    "scenario_id": "C02-OUT1-positive-mixed-artifacts",
    "skill": "dev-graph:run-dev-graph-node",
    "repo_root": "eval-log/dev-graph/live-trial-fixtures/r5-node",
    "graph_revision": graph["graph_revision"],
    "checks": checks,
    "failed_checks": [item["check"] for item in checks if item["status"] != "PASS"],
    "verdict": "PASS" if all(item["status"] == "PASS" for item in checks) else "FAIL",
}
(EVAL / "run-dev-graph-node-final-verification.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
)
print(json.dumps({"verdict": report["verdict"], "failed_checks": report["failed_checks"],
                  "checks": [{item["check"]: item["status"]} for item in checks]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if report["verdict"] == "PASS" else 1)
